remarks: Welcome to this charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath ranch nestled in the Village of Medina! Offering convenient first-floor living, as well as location, with just a short walk from the Erie Canal and Glenwood Lake.  Step inside to find an updated kitchen and dining room, creating a welcoming space for everyday living and entertaining. The enclosed front porch provides a cozy spot to relax and enjoy the neighborhood. Off the dining room, a large deck overlooks the spacious backyard, offering plenty of room for outdoor gatherings, gardening, or simply enjoying the peaceful setting. The property also features multiple storage options, including two storage sheds in the backyard and an additional large storage shed accessible from the double-wide stamped concrete driveway. With its convenient layout, generous yard, ample storage, and proximity to all that the Village of Medina has to offer, this home is ready to welcome its next owner!
